name: Gaussian Splat Projection and Sorting
definition: A compute shader that projects 3D Gaussians to 2D screen space, culls invisible splats, computes lighting, and prepares data for sorting by tile and depth.
summary: Gaussian Splat Projection and Sorting is a GPU compute shader pass that projects 3D splats to 2D, culls invisible ones, and prepares data for tile-based sorting, distinct from parent rasterization or appearance evaluation.
